title: Shape a long cultural feature for reading and wandering
summary: Design a responsive editorial feature that carries a long argument, visual pauses, captions, and a compact chronology.
originNote: A recognizable editorial-design control that makes image-led atmosphere compete with sustained reading.

setup.instructions: Mount the supplied article packet. Build a self-contained static feature page; the abstract SVGs are the only supplied images.

turns.content: Using fixtures/article.json and fixtures/night-map.svg, build a complete responsive cultural feature as index.html. Preserve every supplied paragraph and attribution. Make the page inviting to wander without breaking the long reading path: include a strong opening composition, captions, one pull quote, and the supplied chronology. Do not invent photography, facts, or quotations. Avoid a blog-template stack of identical cards. The article body must be selectable text and the chronology must carry data-section="chronology".
Revise only the opening third so the title and first paragraph no longer compete at the same visual volume. Keep the article text, imagery, chronology, and overall register intact.

checks.description: The chronology is present in the artifact.
Inspect whether the opening leads into a comfortable long-form reading path at mobile and desktop widths.
